fieldNotes.siteIdentity: Site at 300 Reliance Ave was divested by General Mills to Kraft (2010) and now operates as Eastern Shore Forest Products / an agricultural processing facility (banner sign on the gate). Audited as the physical plant at the roster address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link sliding gate across the entrance drive on the property's south frontage, confirmed in Street View (2023-07) - fenced perimeter with a banner sign at the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the gate in any Street View heading; gate appears un-staffed (chain-link slide gate only).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack - treated as remote/self check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Modest dock count along the south face of the main building; estimated 6-10, low confidence from overhead foliage shadow.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers parked along the central building face and a small paved drop area; estimated under 10.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small-town edge setting - residential houses directly across Reliance Ave, woodland on three sides, river to the west. Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Western building, two central connected buildings, and an eastern dark-roof building - 4 distinct structures plus minor outbuildings.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: MDE Brownfield record lists the General Mills/Pillsbury property as 21.31 acres; perimeter box yields ~22 acres gross.

citations.claim: GM divested the Federalsburg MD plant (land, assets, ~85 employees) to Kraft Foods; GM had run it since the 2001 Pillsbury acquisition
Eastern Shore Forest Products purchased the former Kraft-Heinz Federalsburg site

verification.rationale: GM divested Federalsburg to Kraft in 2010; the site now operates as Eastern Shore Forest Products (ag/wood processing). Not GM-operated.
